// WHO WE ARE

Built by a team of 4. Engineered to compete.

Velenthis is an all-girls team of four Grade 9 students from GD Goenka Public School, Sarita Vihar, competing in STEM Racing India — a competition that challenges students to design, build, and race miniature F1-style cars while applying real engineering and entrepreneurial principles.

We handle every side of the project ourselves: designing and manufacturing the car, and building out our own engineering, enterprise, and marketing portfolios — the same disciplines a real motorsport team runs.

At the Regional Finals we placed 7th out of 37 teams and were awarded Best Newcomers for our debut performance — earning our place at the National Finals.

ENGINEERING

Design & Manufacture

CAD modelling, CFD-informed aerodynamics, and precision manufacturing of every car component in-house.

ENTERPRISE

Sponsorship & Strategy

A student-run business arm handling budgets, partner relations, and brand presence — pitched like a real venture.

RACE DAY

Track Performance

Judged on race times, reaction speed, and engineering portfolio at regional and national events.
